rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of multiple occurrences of the same CLI argument
rawFindings.explanation: When the CLI argument is specified multiple times, optimist parses it as an array of values. The original code assigned the array to the option, causing incorrect behavior. The new code attempts to handle this by overriding with the last value. However, the code does this by modifying the iteration variable `argumentValue` after extraction but before assignment, which only affects the local binding and not the array in `argv`. This is acceptable here as it only uses `argumentValue` for assignmen
rawFindings.suggestion: Avoid mutating the original `argv` object. Instead, extract the last value without modifying the original array, e.g., use `argumentValue[argumentValue.length - 1]`.
